visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and a black shirt is shown in a close-up, facing the camera directly in a neutral indoor room. He points his index finger upwards while speaking. The background is a plain, off-white wall with soft indoor lighting. (2) The camera displays a smartphone screen capture of an Instagram poll titled 'Fans decide my day!'. The poll asks 'Where to go for a day trip?' with voting percentages visible. Yellow captions appear on screen. (3) The man is seen with a beige towel over his shoulders, standing in a small room near a closet. He gestures with a peace sign and points to two jackets: a light blue denim jacket and a black one. (4) Close-up shots feature the denim jacket and a black jacket hanging on a door, followed by the man holding two bags—a navy tote and a black tote—looking between them as if undecided. (5) In a split-screen view, the man demonstrates packing the navy tote bag with an umbrella, a wallet, a phone, and a laptop, showcasing the bag's multiple storage compartments. (6) The scene transitions to an outdoor restaurant. The man is shown eating a bowl of rice with duck meat and a fried egg, followed by a shot of him eating a chocolate tart in a cafe. (7) He models the denim outfit and navy tote bag outside a building. He demonstrates various carrying styles: crossbody, shoulder, and handheld. (8) He introduces a black backpack, highlighting the thick padded straps and showing how it fits A4-sized yellow envelopes. The background is an urban street near a storefront. (9) A split-screen displays both the black backpack and the navy tote bag with text overlays about a 7-Eleven flash sale. He holds both bags and smiles at the camera. (10) The video ends with the man on a black background, looking at the camera and posing a question to the viewers to encourage comments.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A young male voice introduces the video with high energy and a friendly tone. A bright, mid-tempo acoustic pop background music starts. The acoustic environment is clean with minimal studio reverb. (2) A short digital 'ping' sound effect marks the appearance of the poll on screen. The narrator's speech rate is fast and enthusiastic, typical of a high-arousal social media greeting. (3) Subtle rustling of fabric is heard as the man points to different outfits. The background music maintains a consistent rhythmic drive with light percussion. (4) During the eating scenes, foley-style sound effects of crunching and chewing are layered over the music. The music volume ducks slightly to prioritize these sensory sound effects. (5) Outdoor ambient street noise is audible but kept very low. The narrator models the bag, and 'whoosh' sound effects emphasize the quick cuts and transitions between different carrying styles. (6) The video concludes with a direct question from the speaker. The music continues until the final frame, providing a cohesive emotional resolution to the promotional message.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Interactive Challenge -> Experiential Journey -> Product Showcase -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the limited-edition Porter International bags available via flash sale at 7-Eleven by framing the product showcase within a popular 'fans decide my day' interactive vlog format.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of products, brand logos shown, and explicit pricing/purchase information provided at the end.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-engagement 'interactive' framing to make an advertisement feel like organic content.
